newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan, Hitachi mull helping Nissan Life -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Nissan, Hitachi mull helping Nissan Life -- paper.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd and Hitachi Ltd are considering putting up capital into a new company that will wind up the operations of Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co, the Japanese daily Mainichi Shimbun reported on Monday.
Kenjiro Hata, chairman of the Life Insurance Association of Japan, said on Friday that a scheme to wind up Nissan Life was expected to be ready in two to three weeks.

Hata told reporters that the insurance body wants to seek capital contributions from major clients of Nissan Life, such as Nissan and Hitachi, if a new company is set up to wind up Nissan Life's operations.
A Hitachi spokesman said he was not able to immediately confirm whether the company had received a request for a capital contribution. A Nissan spokesman was not immediately available to comment.
Nissan Life said last week it expects to report a net loss of 52.5 billion yen for the business year that ended in March and this had forced it to abandon efforts to stay in business.
